title: build(deps): bump fast-uri from 3.1.2 to 3.1.9
body:
Bumps [fast-uri](https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri) from 3.1.2 to 3.1.9.
Release notes

Sourced from fast-uri's releases.

v3.1.9

Security

This security release fixes four URI parsing and normalization vulnerabilities in fast-uri 3.x. Applications that process untrusted URI input should upgrade to v3.1.9.

  • Medium — URI scheme spoofing through percent-encoded schemes (GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, CVE-2026-110306): percent-encoded scheme input is now rejected instead of being decoded into a live scheme.
  • Medium — Host confusion during domain-host canonicalization (GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr, CVE-2026-110180): malformed domain hosts containing ambiguous delimiters or stripped control characters are now rejected instead of being silently rewritten.
  • Low — Incorrect relative-reference normalization (GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h, CVE-2026-110095): dot-segment removal now preserves the resolution semantics of relative references.
  • Low — Scheme injection in suffix references (GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp, CVE-2026-110725): first-segment colons in path-only suffix references are now escaped so the output is not reparsed as a scheme.

Upgrade with:

npm install fast-uri@3.1.9

Thanks to @​zekth for reporting the scheme, host, and relative-reference issues, and to @​UlisesGascon for finding the suffix-reference issue and reviewing the remediations.

What's Changed

  • ci: enable trusted publishing releases (v3.x) by @​mcollina in fastify/fast-uri#229

Full Changelog: https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri/compare/v3.1.8...v3.1.9

v3.1.8

⚠️ Security Warning

This security release fixes the following medium-severity security advisory:

  • GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj — inconsistent host case normalization via percent-encoded octets

Users of the v3.x release line should upgrade to v3.1.8.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri/compare/v3.1.7...v3.1.8

v3.1.7

⚠️ Security Warning

This is a security release that fixes the following high-severity security advisories:

  • GHSA-qw65-cvwx-89v3 — authority injection via an unvalidated port in serialize()
  • GHSA-58mr-gqgx-xq4g — host confusion via unbalanced or misplaced IP-literal brackets

Users of the v3.x release line should upgrade to v3.1.7.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri/compare/v3.1.6...v3.1.7

v3.1.6

⚠️ Security Warning
